hints.Popeye: Squint one eye, clamp a pipe in your mouth, flex your arm, swallow a can of spinach, and bulge your muscles.
hints.Pink Panther: Tiptoe sneakily with long, smooth strides, a finger on your lips and a sly grin, like a cool spy.
hints.Road Runner: Zoom on the spot very fast with legs a blur, stick out your tongue, then let a coyote crash behind you.
hints.Johnny Bravo: Flex your muscles, pat a huge pompadour, pose in sunglasses, and flash a cheesy grin at an imaginary girl.
hints.Ben 10: Press a watch on your wrist, twist it, flash a green light, and transform into a monster, then fight.
hints.Doraemon: Pull a gadget out of a pocket on your tummy, then be a round blue cat with no ears who panics at the sight of a mouse.
hints.Naruto: Run with your arms swept back, make hand seals, split into clones, then shoot a big spinning blast.
hints.Dragon Ball: Cup your hands at your hip, strain and focus, thrust them forward to shoot a beam, and power up with spiky hair.
hints.Courage the Cowardly Dog: Be a shivering dog, stare with huge eyes at a ghost in the window, hide, and then bravely save the owners.
hints.Tweety and Sylvester: Flap tiny wings as a little bird with a big head, then be a big cat chasing it, always failing and crashing.
hints.Inside Out: Show five feelings on your face one after another: joy, sadness, anger, fear and disgust.
hints.Up: Be an old man holding on to a bunch of balloons, floating a house into the sky, with a little scout next to you.
hints.Shrek: Be a big green ogre with trumpet ears, flex like a grumpy giant, walk with a chatty donkey, and peel the layers of an onion.
hints.Frozen: Wave your hands and make ice, fling your arms out in a dramatic pose, and build a snowman who loves warm hugs.
hints.Toy Story: Stand stiff as a toy, go limp when a human walks in, then point one arm up high and fly.
hints.Finding Nemo: Swim around with one small fin, search the ocean with a forgetful friend, and escape a dentist's tank.
hints.The Lion King: Lift a baby up high on a rock, paw the air like a lion, and act as a lion cub growing up, with a long mane.
hints.Aladdin: Rub a lamp, let a big blue genie burst out, then ride a carpet and look around in wonder at a whole new world.
hints.Kung Fu Panda: Show a big round belly and eat a lot, then bow, do kung fu moves, and fall over.
hints.Minions: Bounce about in yellow overalls with goggles, giggle with big goofy gestures, and act as a lot of tiny helpers.
hints.Moana: Row a canoe over big waves, wave to the ocean like an old friend, and dance in a boat with a pet pig and a chicken.
hints.Cars: Be a race car with a steering wheel in front, zoom, drift, and wink with a thumbs-up, then park and sleep.
hints.Ice Age: Chase an acorn like a squirrel, then lumber as a mammoth, a sloth and a tiger across frozen land.
hints.Madagascar: Be zoo animals on a beach: a lion, a zebra, a giraffe and a hippo, with lemurs dancing wildly.
hints.Tom and Jerry: Be a cat chasing a tiny mouse and crashing into things, then be the mouse who tricks the cat.
hints.Mickey Mouse: Make big round ears with your hands and walk with a cheerful bounce in big white gloves.
hints.SpongeBob: Be a square sponge with a huge goofy smile, flipping burgers on a grill.
hints.Donald Duck: Waddle with a beak, then stomp and flap your arms in a furious tantrum.
hints.Bugs Bunny: Hold two fingers up as long ears, chew a carrot casually, and look cool and sly.
hints.Winnie the Pooh: Rub a round belly, stick your hand into a honey pot, and lick your fingers happily.
hints.Dora the Explorer: Wear a small backpack, hold up a map, and march forward with a monkey friend.
hints.Peppa Pig: Push your nose up like a pig and jump up and down in muddy puddles in boots.
hints.Pikachu: Make pointed ears with your hands, spark with your cheeks, and shoot lightning from your fingers.
hints.The Simpsons: Show spiky hair and big round eyes, eat a donut, and sit together on a couch.
hints.Scooby-Doo: Be a scared big dog who hides, runs from a ghost, and gobbles a huge sandwich.
hints.Mr. Bean: Raise your eyebrows in a stiff suit and get into silly trouble while hugging a teddy bear.
hints.Zootopia: Be a bunny police officer saluting proudly, then a sly fox with a smirk, then a sleepy sloth typing very slowly.
hints.Coco: Strum a guitar, dance like a skeleton with stiff bony moves, and gaze tenderly at an old photo.
